Two workloads with equal real footprint but different dtype decide identically -> passes the threshold-divergence test. Not kernel identity, not a bare dtype literal, not an op-pattern proxy. No hard stop. RULE 1b (BREADTH): the lever applies to ALL standard reductions keyed on the workload property, not fenced to flj.
